evidence_boundary.local_discovery: Standard LocalAppData/Programs, Program Files and Program Files (x86) directory listings did not identify VRCT/VRCS installation directories. Initial recursive executable-name glob timed out. This is bounded discovery, not proof that no installation exists anywhere.
evidence_boundary.readiness_rule: Unverified setup/access is blocked, not ready and not unsupported-language N/A. Source language tables alone do not establish engine availability or semantic competence.

tts.source_finding: No built-in TTS route found in inspected feature/config schema; leave external synthesis clients disconnected. audio.output.mode is speaker-input capture, not voice synthesis.

vrct_native_stdin.startup_warning: Online initialization automatically checks/downloads both selected CTranslate2 and Whisper weights, including cloud-only profiles, and checks configured provider credentials. Do not launch under discovery-only restrictions without provisioned assets and isolated access.
vrct_native_stdin.request_shape: One UTF-8 JSON line with endpoint and data; data=null or base64(UTF-8 JSON value).
vrct_native_stdin.response_shape: status, endpoint, result; interleaved logs/events. There is no benchmark request-ID field.
vrct_native_stdin.direction_shape: Complete maps: SELECTED_YOUR_LANGUAGES[tab]['1'] and SELECTED_TARGET_LANGUAGES[tab]['1'..'3'] each contain language, country, enable. Use exactly one enabled target, preserve unrelated entries.
vrct_native_stdin.effective_state_caveat: Read back getters and actual toggle/process state. Translation engines can fall back to CTranslate2; invalid/unavailable Whisper can run Google. Capture/translation booleans are nonpersistent and have no running-state getter in inspected endpoint map. An adapter must not infer running from config.json or echo requested state.
vrct_native_stdin.manual_fallback: Dedicated GUI instance: stop microphone/speaker/OCR; select translation/recognition route and CPU, one language target, exact CABLE Output host/device, Advanced OSC destination, mute synchronization off; enable translation then microphone. Confirm actual state and ten-second audio output before timed work.
vrct_native_stdin.cleanup: Disable owned capture/translation, request shutdown, confirm owned process exit, restore private original config byte-for-byte; do not attach a personal instance.

vrcs_core_http.runtime_prerequisite: Provisioned pinned vrcs-core.exe plus assets; desktop installer alone does not establish a usable standalone executable.
vrcs_core_http.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <private owned session token>. Supply an ephemeral token privately; otherwise core prints generated token to stderr. Never publish token/header or query-token WebSocket URL.
vrcs_core_http.settings_write_semantics: Complete schema-33 settings, not Merge Patch; use fresh x-vrcs-config-revision response header for writes. Profiles are protected; missing revision can preserve ASR selection instead of applying it.
vrcs_core_http.profile_uuid: Use actual UUID returned by profile_create, not a handwritten alias.
vrcs_core_http.state_evidence: GET /health includes service/version, capture_running, capture_requested, microphone_capture_state/device, ASR/VAD status, last_error, OSC status and mute-sync state. GET settings provides effective selection. No actual responses collected.
vrcs_core_http.manual_fallback: Fresh benchmark Windows account for desktop; configure Recognition, API profiles and translation target, CABLE Output audio input and OSC; disable mute sync and speaker capture; global capture control, then health/output checks. Desktop chooses dynamic HTTP port/token and fixed per-user data root.
vrcs_core_http.cleanup: Stop capture; confirm capture_running and capture_requested false; restore original complete settings with fresh revision; delete only newly created credential/profile UUIDs; Ctrl+C owned core; restore private environment and updater preference.

source_rules: Cumulative ASR buffers may yield changing text for one spoken interval in both Google and Whisper routes.
Exact consecutive microphone transcript text is suppressed; changed results can be translated/sent again.
Whole current formatted result is sent by the inspected microphone path; no page, utterance, revision or final IDs are on OSC.
GUI resend resubmits stored original and may retrigger translation.
vrct_source_only.new_utterance_revision_page_resend_disti: Unresolved from OSC alone. No observed pagination or finality rule exists. A different packet is not automatically a new utterance; repeated/longer text does not establish resend/final output.
vrct_source_only.revision_dependent_metrics: N/A until actual stream evidence supports a bounded per-app rule

source_rules: Automatic chatbox output is microphone-based; speaker subtitles alone do not establish OSC sends.
Eligible late translation can resend/update current output; an original-only packet followed by translated/bilingual text can belong to one utterance.
Automatic formatting applies a 144-character limit and truncation, not an OSC page-ID protocol.
Internal subtitle/message identities and resend diagnostics are not included in OSC arguments.
vrcs_source_only.new_utterance_revision_page_resend_disti: Unresolved empirically. Text similarity, send timing and TTL do not uniquely identify new utterances, revisions or resends; local diagnostic IDs must remain separate from raw common endpoint evidence.
vrcs_source_only.revision_dependent_metrics: N/A until actual stream evidence supports a bounded per-app rule
